claim: The CloudHSM hsm1.medium instance type reaches end of support on March 31st, 2026. Starting April 2025 you cannot create new hsm1.medium clusters, and starting January 2026 AWS begins to migrate existing hsm1.medium clusters automatically to the hsm2m.medium instance type.

evidence.quote: The AWS CloudHSM hsm1.medium instance type will reach its end of support on March 31st, 2026.
Starting April 2025, you won't be able to create new hsm1.medium clusters.
Starting January 2026, we will begin automatically migrating existing hsm1.medium clusters to the new hsm2m.medium instance type.

note: d094. adjudicate-06: the FIPS 140-2 Level 3 FAQ quote was removed; it did not tie the level to hsm1.medium.
